column1: # DayDream check manifest: one row per runner step that must appear in SUMMARY (compile-X belongs to row X).
# Read by scripts/verify-run-manifest.py, whose verdict is the run's result (runner-1001/run-checks.sh).
# lane: smoke | setup-ui | capture | storage | ai-tools | release | perf   (LANES=a,b runs those lanes plus the builds)
# config: owner (both shipped flags, the release configuration) | public-contract (pins on the unflagged build a
#   contributor gets) | public (unflagged objects; Phase 2 moves these onto the owner build) | n/a (source scans)
# needs: headless | window (Phase 2 window lane) | typesense | model
# min_pass: fewest PASS lines the step must print (blank = prints none: builds, JSON-reporting steps). A known failure needs one.
# status: required | known-failure (reason, since, review_by and min_pass required; its exit code and FAIL lines are
#   pinned in scripts/checks-known-failures.tsv, any other failure is FAIL; passing is XPASS) | window-only (dated too)
